resources.string: Scale account, selected person and local history

Unofficial experimental adapter: reads available scale history directly from Xiaomi. Xiaomi Home stays installed. No Fitness Hub server. Current account, region and firmware compatibility must be tested on your phone.
Xiaomi login is disabled in this test build
Cloud login requires this approved private certificate and a non-debuggable release APK. Public TEST/debug or differently signed APKs remain blocked. Saved history remains available offline.
Account connected; choose your person and scale before importing
Cloud synchronization is unavailable for this account/source
Use the server region configured in Xiaomi Home, not your current location.
Connect directly to Xiaomi to read the scale data accessible to this account.
Model identifiers are not a guarantee of hardware compatibility. S400 Pro and regional firmware remain unverified.
Unverified model: fields with unconfirmed units will not be silently normalized.
Find people and scales in history
Only identities found in the requested history are shown, not every member of a Xiaomi household. Discovery does not save their measurements.
Pages examined: %1$d · source rows: %2$d · unresolved identities: %3$d
No selectable source in the pages examined. Check region/model or examine older pages.
Confirm that these identifiers belong to your profile in Xiaomi Home. This build keeps one fixed person/scale binding; logout will not change its owner.
The requested pass reached the source page boundary. This does not prove that Xiaomi exposed every historical record.
This batch is saved. Continue to download older pages from the saved checkpoint.
Source selected. Start importing when ready.
Account connected. Login does not start an automatic import.
Operation stopped. Already committed pages remain saved.
Remove the service session and cancel its operations? Saved measurements and the selected archive owner will remain unchanged.
Source snapshots saved: %1$d. Different versions may refer to the same weighing; this is not a deduplicated event count.
Last page saved: %1$s · pages in current pass: %2$d
No Xiaomi Cloud records stored. CSV, Bluetooth and Health Connect data remain in their existing sections.
Values and methods from the source, without local recalculation. Missing or uncertain units are not treated as verified measurements.
This local record could not be interpreted. It has not been changed or deleted.
Sign in again. The session is missing, expired or no longer accepted.
Xiaomi requires CAPTCHA or additional verification. Completing this challenge is not supported yet; no bypass or automatic password retry will run.
The account, person or device does not match this archive. Nothing was reassigned. Recheck the selected source.
Connection interrupted or temporarily unavailable. Saved pages remain intact; retry manually.
Xiaomi temporarily limited requests. Wait before retrying; no automatic retry loop is running.
The response, identity or endpoint could not be verified. Import stopped rather than treating the failure as empty data.
Local operation failed. No successful import is being claimed; keep the existing archive.
